title: Investigate and fix shadow-index race causing intermittent dashboard gaps and missing tenant metrics
creator: Sophie Martinez
description: Summary: Several hosted and dedicated customers reported intermittent missing timeseries and blank dashboard tiles during peak ingest windows. Investigation points to a race between shard tombstone compaction and the shadow index writer during leadership transfer on ingest nodes. Symptoms include: (1) 0-value or empty tiles for a 15-90s window, (2) traces missing span-to-metric links, (3) dashboards automatically recovering after compaction re-run. Impact: high for a small set of tenants (notably ACMECorp-hosted, FinApp-dedicated) causing production alerts and support escalations. Goal: deliver a safe patch that prevents metric index drops during leader transitions, add a conservative backfill to rehydrate any dropped series, and add monitoring/alerting to detect regressions.
comments: 2026-03-01 09:12 - Sophie Martinez: Ticket opened after SOC alert and customer escalations. Initial triage shows gaps align with ingest leader failovers and shard compaction schedules.

2026-03-01 11:40 - Arjun Patel: Reproduced locally with a compacted ingest node under synthetic load. Observed missing index entries written to shadow-index and tombstone applied before WAL flush on follower promotion. Added logging to ingestion pipeline and increased tombstone monotonic counter.

2026-03-02 16:05 - Eng oncall (Jin Park): Short mitigation deployed: bump compaction throttle and temporarily disable aggressive tombstone pruning during leader reassign. Reduced customer impact but not ideal long term.

2026-03-03 10:30 - Arjun Patel: Implemented fix: ensure shadow-index writer waits for WAL sync on leadership changes; add a per-shard 'pending-compact' flag to serialize compaction vs leader-promotion. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest-service/pull/7423. Unit tests added to simulate leader transfer race.

2026-03-04 14:20 - QA (Maya Chen): Running integration test harness with 1000 tenants and leader flaps. Observability team requested an additional e2e that asserts no series loss after 2x promotion events.
2026-03-05 09:01 - Support (Liam O'Neill): Notified impacted customers (ACMECorp, FinApp) about planned rolling deploy and offered targeted backfill if they still see gaps post-deploy.

2026-03-06 03:25 - Arjun Patel: Backfill tool implemented (shadow-index-rehydrate v1). It reads tombstone markers and WAL snapshots to reconstruct missing index entries for a tenant/time-range. Dry-run on staging rehydrated ~98% of artificially dropped series.
2026-03-06 18:00 - Release lead (Tara Gomez): Scheduled rolling deploy to ingest pool with feature flag 'kvcache-leader-safety' enabled. Gradual rollout 10% -> 50% -> 100% with active canary checks.

2026-03-07 02:45 - Monitoring (Evan Brooks): Added two new alerts: 'shadow-index-write-failures > 5m' and 'tenant-timeseries-gap-rate > 0.5% over 10m'. Dashboards created: 'Shadow Index Health' and 'Rehydrate Backfill Progress'.
2026-03-07 13:12 - Arjun Patel: PR merged and staged to canary. Canary run (10%) saw no regressions for 48h. Backfill run queued for ACMECorp nightly window if any residual gaps are reported.

2026-03-08 08:30 - Customer Success (Nina Alvarez): ACMECorp confirmed dashboards returned to normal after canary and no further alerts during their morning peak. FinApp asked for a preventive backfill; scheduled for 2026-03-09 01:00 UTC.

Follow-ups / Postmortem actions: 1) Add a chaos test that simulates leader promotion during compaction (owner: Eng Reliability). 2) Document shadow-index semantics and WAL ordering in the runbook (owner: Docs). 3) Evaluate longer-term: transactional commit path for shadow-index or move to a single-writer shard design (owner: Architecture).
